_about: Real structures from the Protein Data Bank (public domain), read with Biopython. ca = C-alpha coordinates (A, centred), ss = 0 coil 1 helix 2 strand (from C-alpha geometry), phi and psi in degrees, burial = number of C-alpha atoms within 10 A. rama[psi_bin][phi_bin] = 2 favoured, 1 allowed, 0 outlier (empirical, 10-degree bins, from the residues of many real chains). refAlign = structure-based alignment (target index, template index).
